messages.author: Dana
messages.text: I already explained this last week. It's obviously a config issue, not a code one.

messages.author: Sam
messages.text: Good point Dana — building on that, could we also check whether the cache is stale?

messages.author: Priya
messages.text: That won't work for the EU region though, because the config there is read-only at runtime.

messages.author: Marcus
messages.text: Not my job to fix the deploy pipeline, you'll have to file a ticket with platform.

messages.author: Lena
messages.text: What does everyone think — should we roll back first and debug after?

messages.author: Dana
messages.text: Anyone who's worked here long enough knows we never roll back on a Friday.

messages.author: Sam
messages.text: Fair. Lena raised a good option though — want me to draft the rollback plan so we have it ready?

messages.author: Priya
messages.text: Here's how we can unblock Marcus: I can grant temporary platform access so he doesn't wait on a ticket.

messages.author: Marcus
messages.text: That's a naive take, Priya — access isn't the bottleneck, the approval chain is.

messages.author: Lena
messages.text: Thanks Priya, that's the idea I was missing. Let's go with your access approach.
